convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for FisherCGOscillator (custom indicator) and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trading logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_). These external dependencies require manual replication in Python.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal triggers SELL_Close when SellPosClose=true, sell signal triggers BUY_Close when BuyPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE=deposit fraction, LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=risk-based on loss share. Default mode LOT overrides the 0.1 MM fraction to use fixed lot sizing.

custom_logic_notes: Crossover detection uses previous bar values (index [1]) to confirm direction, then checks current bar (index [0]) for the actual cross. When SignalBar=0, the new-bar guard is bypassed allowing intrabar recalculation. The Recount flag forces re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are calculated as last bar date plus timeframe period in seconds, likely used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade management or expiration logic.
python_conversion_notes: Must implement FisherCGOscillator custom indicator (CyberCycle with Fisher transform). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_) need full reimplementation. The MarginMode enum with 5 sizing modes requires careful translation. Crossover logic uses shifted buffer access: Ind[1]>Sign[1] (prev bar main > prev bar signal) combined with Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (current bar main <= current bar signal) for buy entry — this is a standard crossover detection pattern. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so no digit adjustment is needed as points are already _Point-denominated. Deviation parameter (10 points) maps to slippage tolerance.
